profile.summary: Ever Forward Club is a youth mentoring organization in the Bay Area, founded in 2004. It works with middle and high school students through year-long mentoring clubs, peer mentoring, and a social-emotional leadership program. Its stated goals are to address dropout rates, youth violence and achievement gaps.
